_comment: The CUDA preset, recorded as measured. The URLs below are placeholders: copy this file to the node's runs/fleet.local.json and put the real addresses there, per presets/README.md. Give each engine its node's ordinary routed address, not a fabric ULA - these hosts run no IPoIB, so the 400G HCAs carry no IP and every IP-level path rides the primary NIC. That costs nothing at the transfer layer, where NIXL addresses the HCAs by LID over RDMA; see manifest.md.
_slo_comment: MEASURED ON THE OFFLOADED SHAPE, NOT B200 SERVING NUMBERS. Calibrated 2026-08-15 at 2x light-load p99, the same rule as the reference preset, against engines whose experts spill to host RAM: measured TPOT floor 1.050 s (b1) and 0.994 s (b2), flat against concurrency because the expert transfer is per-forward-pass and amortizes across the batch. That floor is PCIe, not silicon. The reference fleet's 0.06 s target is unreachable here at any fleet size, and narwhal-check says so. Reset these to the reference values the moment the fleet runs resident.
